name: Desktop notifications

1.how: org.freedesktop.Notifications on the session bus: Notify(app, id, icon, summary, body, actions, hints, timeout); NotificationClosed and ActionInvoked signals. Read incoming ones with `busctl --user monitor org.freedesktop.Notifications` or `dbus-monitor "interface='org.freedesktop.Notifications'"`.
1.notes: Sending is maus sys notify. Monitoring is a Phase 2 observation source (what the user was told, by which app).

1.how: notify-send -a <app> -u low|normal|critical -A action=label <summary> <body> (prints the chosen action); makoctl list|dismiss|restore (Omarchy 3) / Quickshell's own service (Omarchy 4)

quirks: Action buttons depend on the notification daemon; Omarchy 4's Quickshell supports them.
